customer: hey so im selling my cargo van to northwind since were going down to one car, do i still need to pay the loan on it this month?? dont want to pay twice if your paying it off
agent: Yes, please keep making your regular loan payments until your lender confirms the loan is paid off. Our payoff covers the amount your lender quoted, and a missed payment in the meantime can be reported as late on your credit history. If a payment goes through after the payoff, your lender will refund it to you; you can find more in our article Getting back an extra loan payment.
